Questions, answered.

What will I receive?

A personalized 12-page US Letter digital PDF.

Do I need design experience?

No. Share photos and answers; the magazine follows a fixed page structure.

Does the free preview upload my photo?

No. The optional cover photo is previewed from a browser-local object URL. The free preview makes no AI calls.

Why is an account required?

An authenticated account is required to access the private order workspace.

What is included in the revision?

The US$39.99 product includes one bounded revision batch.

How long are project files kept?

After final delivery, source photos and working files are deleted within 24 hours. The final PDF remains available for 72 hours.
